# Motion Control Lab vendoring note

This directory contains the ordinary source archive for FTXUI `v7.0.3`:

- upstream: <https://github.com/ArthurSonzogni/FTXUI>
- release tag: `v7.0.3`
- upstream commit: `f921fad208912747c17d129a8ef75ec7624b6eec`
- downloaded archive SHA-256:
  `e7c62ffe19009759821b4f0f8df7f2a6fb83784c3a9f1477d81f56d3ee723c88`

The archive was extracted directly into this directory. It is not a Git
submodule and contains no nested `.git` repository. Motion Control Lab builds
the source directly with examples, documentation, modules, upstream tests, and
installation disabled.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
